podcast.title: Avoided by Dreampunk
podcast.body: Dreampunk consciously avoids the typical sampling and looping techniques associated with Plunderphonics, opting instead for abstract soundscapes. "A diferencia del vaporwave, evita las técnicas de Sampleo y Lupéo típicas del Plonder Phonics"

srcs.episode: Vaporwave: Mucho más que un Meme

podcast.title: Inspiration for Eccojams Techniques
podcast.body: Plunderphonics is a technique that inspired Eccojams, particularly its method of slowing down and fragmenting tracks to give them a glitch effect. "El Eco Yams toma inspiración de técnicas como el Chopeta N' Escriway o el Plonder Phonics, ralentizando y fragmentando las pistas para darle un toque glitch."
